what: Platina | Live in Yerevan, stage LIGHT scenes v3: one scene and one beam variant per kept v3 screen look, the drops and effects, and a stress block at the end
source: written by scripts/place/platina_scenes_v3.py from the rig scripts/place/rigs/platina-rig-2026-11-11.json; colours and rules from the 22-scene spec scripts/place/rigs/platina-scenes-spec-2026-11-11.json; the kept screen looks are the visuals lane's verdict of 2026-11-11

rules.laser: none on this show: every scene laser null
rules.beams: XP-16R white/open only; heads patterns on XP-16R only (kinds acme-xp16r-bsw)
rules.hold: hold_s is total time on, fade inside it, never 0
rules.stress: ids starting stress- are the machine's load test at the end of the cue list, never a show cue

scenes.title: Work light
scenes.intent: Load-in and focus: plain white, nothing moves.

scenes.title: Doors
scenes.intent: The room as people come in: a low deep blue from the floor, the screen leads.

scenes.title: Waiting
scenes.intent: Minutes before: towers breathe magenta, the hung beams stand as a quiet white fan.

scenes.title: Entry
scenes.intent: He walks on: only the white fan, full.

scenes.title: Magenta room
scenes.intent: The room is one magenta volume, breathing. No beams: the screen look carries the lines.

scenes.title: Magenta room, white fan
scenes.intent: Same room, the hung beams added as a slow wave through the magenta.

scenes.title: Red verticals
scenes.intent: Wash dark, the towers red and hard, running upward; narrow and vertical, not a flood.

scenes.title: Red verticals, white X
scenes.intent: The red towers with every beam lamp crossing in white: the rental picture's X.

scenes.title: Ice line
scenes.intent: Cold and thin: ice towers on a slow vertical sine over a deep blue floor.

scenes.title: Ice line, floor beams
scenes.intent: The ice line with the five deck beams nodding in turn: white needles from the floor.

scenes.title: Cathedral
scenes.intent: A room of standing white beams, hung and floor, wide open; towers ice and white, passing side to side.

scenes.title: Cathedral, turning
scenes.intent: The cathedral turns: every beam on a slow circle, one after another.

scenes.title: White back
scenes.intent: Silhouette: white from the floor row behind him, towers low, nothing from above.

scenes.title: White back, rising beams
scenes.intent: The silhouette with the deck beams rising and falling together behind him.

scenes.title: Freeze
scenes.intent: The breath before a drop: the white fan alone, still.

scenes.title: Drop hit
scenes.intent: One white hit of the whole rig, a second and a half.

scenes.title: Drop, magenta
scenes.intent: Drop one: everything magenta, pumping on the beat outward from the centre, beams in figure eights.

scenes.title: Drop, red
scenes.intent: Drop two: red towers at double time, a fast white X.

scenes.title: Drop, cathedral
scenes.intent: Drop three: white beams sweeping wide, ice and white towers.

scenes.title: Build, ice
scenes.intent: Twelve seconds of rising ice into a drop.

scenes.title: Effect: white strobe
scenes.intent: The towers and the top wash as a white strobe, held to three flashes a second.

scenes.title: Effect: ice sparkle
scenes.intent: Ice towers as scattered sparks over a dark blue floor.

scenes.title: Effect: red radar
scenes.intent: One red line turning through the towers, the hung beams sweeping with it.

scenes.title: Effect: magenta and ice blocks
scenes.intent: Towers in two colours switching by blocks on the beat, violet from above.

scenes.title: Effect: glitch words
scenes.intent: Grey room, towers breaking between grey and the words red; beams nod out of step.

scenes.title: Effect: bars
scenes.intent: Each tower as a level bar rising and falling, magenta.

scenes.title: Encore
scenes.intent: Everything he had tonight at once: magenta room, ice and magenta towers, the full white fan.

scenes.title: Bow
scenes.intent: Plain warm-free white on the stage for the bow.

scenes.title: Blackout
scenes.intent: Out.

scenes.title: House
scenes.intent: People leave: the top wash, white, half.

scenes.title: STRESS: every lamp, white, full
scenes.intent: Load test: all 52 lamps at full white, the beams on the fastest figure eight.

scenes.title: STRESS: every lamp, colour, chase
scenes.intent: Load test: all lamps lit in three colours, a fast chase, the beams on fast circles.

scenes.title: STRESS: hard cut 1 of 4
scenes.intent: Load test: a hard cut of the whole rig every second (one change a second, under the flash limit).

scenes.title: STRESS: hard cut 2 of 4
scenes.intent: Load test: a hard cut of the whole rig every second (one change a second, under the flash limit).

scenes.title: STRESS: hard cut 3 of 4
scenes.intent: Load test: a hard cut of the whole rig every second (one change a second, under the flash limit).

scenes.title: STRESS: hard cut 4 of 4
scenes.intent: Load test: a hard cut of the whole rig every second (one change a second, under the flash limit).
